title: Intermediate
description: This level has been created in Unity using ProBuilder and the Human: Fall Flat Workshop prefabs. It gives an example of how the prefabs can be manipulated to create unique levels. This level has a totally different aesthetic to the levels in the core game, as the intention here is to show what else can be done using prefabs, node graph knowledge and basic ProBuilder. This level is intended to show how the node graph system can be used to move geometry and create game play events and also features multiple checkpoints. We hope you have as much fun playing it and discovering how it all functions, as we did in building it for you! You can make levels too! It's possible to learn Unity quite quickly. If you want to get started, there is a Workshop guide that will tell you all the basics for making your first level, as well as others that provide more detailed once you've learnt the basics: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1619459875 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667236910 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667523402 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667318218 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1672639933 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1752966731 After you've made it through these guides, there are also a few YouTube tutorials from Gotcha on how they've created some of the fun obstacles in their levels. They can be found on their YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmsNnTYJv_40IyxziHb9qPg There's also a Discord channel where you'll be able to chat with thousands of HFF fans - http://discord.gg/hff There is a dedicated WORKSHOP-SUPPORT channel, which is the place to go if you need a little help and your question has not been answered by our guides. Head there to ask and quickly get help from the community. I'm Mildred Bumble#3267 on Discord. Please feel free to give me a shout! If you want something fixing as a priority I will add it to our backlog of work. Go on, give it a try!

Play a game at a time. Multiplayer animation still has some bugs, everything is subject to the host display. But don't worry, all problems can be solved by resetting. [h1]Map introduction[/h1] [b]Pay attention in advance:[/b] The regular checkpoint was cancelled and changed to a bed.Checkpoints need to be actively triggered as optional transfer points, reload checkpoint is still valid after restarting the game. Don't play in the pipe, you will be pulled a mess [b]Large bowl area[/b] Victory condition: Keep yourself in the ball and keep it in the bowl for 100 seconds to win.Leaving the ball or falling out of the bowl will reset the time. Precautions: When the ball starts to fall, press the space bar to jump, so as not to fly out of the platform because the speed is too fast. [b]Football area[/b] Victory condition： First to score nine goals. Precautions: Enter ~FPS to open the first person. [b]Arena[/b] Victory condition： Take the weapon and climb the high ground, waiting for the indication to survive. Precautions: Don't point your gun at yourself.A weapon that is not in the hands of any player will not cause damage. In order to increase the gameplay, attacks using cold weapons will have a chance to fail. [b]Eravitational Interference Equipment Area[/b] Victory condition： Use this device to blow your friends to the sky! Precautions: You can ride on the device and blow yourself up, please pay attention to safety. [b]puzzles:[/b] [spoiler]Do[/spoiler] we have [spoiler]it?[/spoiler] [b]For more details on the gameplay, please go to the project area entry in the game and type ~FPS to switch to the first person view browsing help board. 95% of the content in the map is original, please do not commercialize these models.[/b]

title: Journey to Valhalla, Part 2 (Svartalfheim)
description: If one wishes to journey to Valhalla without being slain, one must first overcome all of Odins challenges. Odin tasked the dwarves of Svartalfheim to craft these challenges. Each realm has its own unique challenge you must complete, starting with Svartalfheim. Explore dark caves, travel through ancient dwarven buildings, ride the minecart and get to the treasure which is required to progress on your journey to Valhalla. This is the second part of my series, which takes place in the realm of dwarves, Svartalfheim. This map may not run very well on low-end pcs. *please note* This is sort of an experimental map, as it is all located inside a cave. I've tried my best at making the checkpoints not respawn you outside of the map, but such issues may still occur. If this happens, simply try and load the last checkpoint. *ALSO please note* The torches at the beginning may turn off due to low video settings. Only way to fix this is increase the settings at least until you are past that point. Can be done in singleplayer. I hope you enjoy this map, if you have any suggestions, feedback, critique, bug issues or any other words, please post a comment :D

title: Beginner
description: This level has been designed to give an example of a minimalist level, whilst still having some basic game logic. It has all the regular level prerequisites and features one checkpoint. This level shows how a simple level can be made in Unity without having to use ProBuilder and having only a very light understanding of the node graph system. The level uses Workshop prefabs from Mansion, Carry, Castle, Aztec and Dark, along with Unity’s built in 3D primitives, the intention here being to show how a level can be made with limited experience. You can make levels too! It's possible to learn Unity quite quickly. If you want to get started, there is a Workshop guide that will tell you all the basics for making your first level, as well as others that provide more detailed once you've learnt the basics: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1619459875 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667236910 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667523402 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667318218 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1672639933 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1752966731 After you've made it through these guides, there are also a few YouTube tutorials from Gotcha on how they've created some of the fun obstacles in their levels. They can be found on their YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmsNnTYJv_40IyxziHb9qPg There's also a Discord channel where you'll be able to chat with thousands of HFF fans - http://discord.gg/hff There is a dedicated WORKSHOP-SUPPORT channel, which is the place to go if you need a little help and your question has not been answered by our guides. Head there to ask and quickly get help from the community. I'm Mildred Bumble#3267 on Discord. Please feel free to give me a shout! If you want something fixing as a priority I will add it to our backlog of work. Go on, give it a try!

title: 【浪味仙】·THE LOST TEAR·
description: 宣传片 → https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Mk4y1B78u ENGLISH—————————————————————————————— ******** Contains THE FIRST FREE-DRIVING airplane and car ********(red = unlock pedal) ******** There are hidden levels in this map ******** Prologue "The largest iceberg that broke from the Ross ice shelf in Antarctica is dangerously approaching the equator..." Sensational news is broadcast on TV. Iceberg? At the equator? Turning off the boring TV, we decide to go to the sea to have a good time... In this rare resort, it is too bad to get bored in the hotel! ……………… Where are we? What just happened? My head hurts... our ship... oh my god... is this what the news says... iceberg? ? ? GUYS! Wake up! We are in big trouble... LEVEL 1 The boat is destroyed... the cans are also broken a lot. Fortunately, there are still some intact ones. We build a bridge with broken cans and broken boxes, barely swimming along the ice floes to a desert island. The unbroken canned food is barely enough for us to eat for a few days... I hope. LEVEL 2 This is an uninhabited island, seems to have nothing except for us and the fragments of our ship... Oh wait, there are coconuts on the island, and even better, there is another box of canned food! We make a small tent from the leaves of the coconut trees, and can live on it tonight. Using floating coconuts and the intact box (compared to the previous broken one), we successfully make a raft ourselves, saying goodbye to the "warm little home" built by coconut leaves. We head towards the huge island ahead, hoping for someone there. LEVEL 3 We finally land on the huge island. There seem to be some houses here... oh no, could it be... the ruins? We walk in and look around. There was no sign of people living, indeed ruins... But we found something on the mountain, and we decide to move on and see. Moving the boulder of the altar together and climbed onto the ruined roof. It collapses as soon as we are about to climb it. This is not the destruction of ruins, is it? In front, there is a suspension bridge. Just across the suspension bridge, the bridge collapses! Fortunately, we move quickly and pass by. There is a shovel in the ground in front... Has anyone been here before? We dug down a few times with a shovel, and we hear a clatter—a huge vertical cave was artificially cut inside the mountain! we come to an island in twin mountains along the cave. LEVEL 4 There is also a cave here, but it is blocked by boulders. Hum, Give me a fulcrum, I can pry up the earth! We pry open the boulder and find that there is a huge ancient ruinst! We unlock various mechanical puzzles with wisdom, and successfully came to the top of the ruinst and walk out of the cave. After bypassing a small garden, the canyon of twin mountains cames into view, "Wow, it's splendid!", we shocked. However, beauty is always short-lived, and we have to move on. The cliff in front is very steep. Grabbing the tree roots, the rocks underneath roll into the sea, if any of us rolls down from here... I'm afraid... After experiencing fear, we eventually walk over the cliff and find... a car! ?? The car has already hit the tree, and the people on the car are missing. But we successfully start it! In the trunk of the car, we find a mysterious golden ball, as well as some unreadable ancient books. We drive forward and see a gold py...pyramid!! LEVEL 5 Curiosity is urging us to explore this strange pyramid built on the island. We come to the door of the pyramid, but the stone door is tightly closed. Someone suddenly remembers the mysterious golden ball in the car and we decide to try it with the golden ball on the altar---the door opens! We walk into this mysterious building with excitement and fear.................. -THE LOST TEAR- 中文———————————————————————————————— ******** 内含首个可自由驾驶的 飞机 与 汽车！********(红色 = 解锁脚踏) ******** 地图中含有隐藏关卡 ******** 序 “从南极洲的罗斯冰架上断裂出来的最大冰山，正在危险地靠近赤道…” 电视里播着耸人听闻的新闻，冰山？在赤道？关掉无聊的电视，我们决定去海上好好玩一圈——在这难得的度假胜地，闷在酒店可太糟糕了！ ……………… 我们在哪？刚刚发生啥了？头好痛…我们的船…哦天哪…这难道是新闻里说的……冰山？？？大家快醒醒！我们遇到大麻烦了… LEVEL 1 船已经稀巴烂了…罐头也摔碎了好多，万幸还有一些没摔碎的，我们用摔烂的罐头和破碎的箱子搭成桥，勉强沿着浮冰游到了一个荒岛。完好的罐头勉强够我们吃几天吧，但愿。 LEVEL 2 这是一个无人岛，除了我们和我们船的碎片…似乎什么也没有。哦等等，岛上有椰子，更妙的是还有另一箱罐头！我们用椰树的叶子做成了一个小帐篷，今夜就靠它度过吧。 利用漂浮的椰子和完好无损的（相比之前那个破碎不堪的来讲）罐头箱子，我们自己成功做了一艘木筏，告别了椰树叶搭建的“温馨小家”，我们向前方巨大的岛屿前进了，希望那里能有人烟。 LEVEL 3 终于登岛了，这里似乎有一些房子——哦不，莫非是…遗迹？我们进去查看了一圈，没有人居住的气息，果然是遗迹。不过我们发现山上似乎有什么东西，我们决定继续前进看看。合力搬来祭坛的巨石，爬上遗迹坍塌的屋顶（我们刚要爬他就塌了，这不算破坏文物吧？），前方是一个吊桥。 刚刚走过吊桥，桥就整个塌掉了！还好我们动作敏捷，和死神擦身而过。前方有一个铲子插在地里…难道之前有人来过？我们用铲子往下挖了几下，就听哗啦一声——山体里面居然被人为开凿出了巨大的垂直山洞！ 沿着山洞前进，我们来到了一个双峰山的岛屿。 LEVEL 4 这里也有一个山洞，不过被巨石堵住了。哼哼，给我一个杠杆，我能翘起一个地球！我们撬开巨石，发现里面居然是一个巨大的古迹！ 我们用聪明的小脑瓜解开各种机关，顺利来到了古迹上方，走出了山洞。绕过一片小花园之后，双峰峡谷映入眼帘，“哇，好美鸭！”我们不禁感叹道。 然而美丽总是短暂的，我们还要继续前进，而前方的悬崖，很险峻。抓着树根，脚下的岩石滚落入海，如果是我们中的哪个人从这里滚落下去…恐怕… 提心吊胆之后，我们成功走过了悬崖，然后发现了…一辆汽车！？？车早已撞在树上，车上的人也不知所踪，不过我们成功启动了它！在汽车的行李箱里，我们发现了一个神秘的金球，以及一些看不懂的古籍。 我们开车前进，看到了一个…金…金字塔！ LEVEL 5 好奇心在催我们去探索这座建在岛上的奇怪金字塔，我们来到金字塔门前，然而石门关得紧紧的。不知谁突然想起来车里神秘的金球，决定用金球扔到祭坛上试试——门还真就这么开了！ 我们一行人既兴奋又害怕的走进这作神秘的建筑………………… -浪味仙·THE LOST TEAR- 感谢 夜雨微澜 和 壁咚桑 对的英文版说明的贡献~

title: Storybook
description: Once upon a wibble-wobble, in a world not so far away, you stumble into a land where fairytales come alive! Get ready to giggle, wobble, and puzzle your way through "Storybrook", my entry for the Human Fall Flat Workshop Competition (Theme: Fairytale). Possible Achievement (1): Hot Off the Press - Use the furnace to get to the magical book. Possible Achievement (2): Shelf-Care – Find all 6 golden books and throw them off the map. Possible Achievement (3): Sharp Shooter – Hit the middle of the target. Possible Achievement (4): Sky's the Limit – Open the heavenly gate and complete the level. Without any shortcut and hunting all the achievements, you will need at least ~12 minutes. If (intended) shortcuts are taken, you will already be done in ~ 4 min. SPOILERS AHEAD: You begin in a cozy library where tall bookshelves line the walls, and a giant book hovers above you. A tiny shimmer already guides you the way: You need to reach that book… You'll need to use the bookshelves as stairs or, just jump into the furnace to get up there… Eventually the book will enable you to enter a new world! Misty Mysteries After your bookish leap, you land in an enchanted forest, where thick fog covers the ground. To find your way through this spooky swamp, use one of the glowing mushrooms to clear the fog. You can take several ways through, either the wooden bridge, water lilies or take the dry route to avoid getting swampy. You may also be able to find a shortcut here, try it out! Gingerbread Getaway Next stop: a land full of sweets where calories don't count. To move forward, you'll need to climb the gingerbread house and towers made of candy. Not able to reach one of the candy towers? Well, try to use this handy candy cart as a bridge. Eventually, grab a candy cane and slide to the next part, but be careful not to sugar crash! Tricky Tower You now face a tower... Use the platforms to make your way to the top. Once there, stand on the magic spot in front of the mirror to summon a crown – it's time to get your bling on! Or, if you're feeling like a sneaky hero, find the hidden book-lever above the chest (it’s the one out of line). Pull it to reveal a shortcut. If you decide to go the magical door route, you'll need to swing across using rusty chains. It's an adventure either way! Miner's Mission On the other side of the river, you’ll need dynamite to blast your way through. Boom, baby! Once inside the cave, navigate the sparkling crystal labyrinth to find your way to the next island. It's a gem of a challenge! Leafy Lift Finally, you reach a small field. Use the slingshot to hit the target and plant one of the beans in a pot. Now, fill the watering can from the well and watch your magical bean grow into a giant tendril! If your timing is right, it’ll lift you sky-high. Missed it? No worries, just leaf it to the leaves and climb up. Heavenly Heights Over the clouds, you’ll find a celestial gate. The stairs seem to disappear once in a while, you may not be able to use all the stairs up to the gate, so just use the cloudy railing. However, you need to step through the gate and take one last fall to complete the level. It's the grand finale, so make it a graceful dive! Where to find the books? (1) Next to a tree on the left of the swamp (within the fog). (2) Inside a doughnut next to the candy slide. (3) Within the cave – Heading right twice after the entrance. (4) Within the secret part of the tower on the stone floor below the stairs – Reachable when using the secret path or coming from the cave (5) Behind the archery target (6) Stage above the cave, next to the water – Reachable when tendril grew. You need to get past a few trees to reach it.

description: Complete obstacle courses and find the key objects to make your way across the city. Level walkthrough: - Climb on platforms and press all 3 red buttons to open the building doors. - Each building has a green object located at the top floor. - Take the 3 green objects one by one and put them in the box with shapes on it. - A key will drop from the small box once you placed all 3 objects. - Take the key and put it in the keyhole to release the large ball. - Next area has 3 switches on walls and another green object that will help you get to the other side. - Go left on the bridge and then in the tunnel. - Find the knife in the building and cut the rope to release the platform in the water. - Jump on platforms and press the red button to open the hotel door. - Take the elevator to the top floor and find the green star. Put it in the box located on the 3rd floor to open the next door. - Go through the short maze to the last checkpoint. - Wait for a plane to push down the hook above and catch it. - Pull down the blue door with the hook and get through the spinning room. - Grab the brick with green sides and put it in the small box. The exit is now activated. - Smash the window, jump down and drive the truck off the cliff to end the level.

title: 小布点-黎明 （Dawn）
description: 黎明--- 经测试，本地图所有关卡均可正常通关，无需大跳爬墙，如有不懂或过不去的地方，可以到优酷、哔哩哔哩搜索‘小布点的布’查看通关攻略，也可以到斗鱼（2129932）找到作者，让作者亲自告诉您！ 本图由于太多身临其境的现实生活事物写照，为了更好的游戏体验请打开游戏音效，感受游戏带来的快乐 ~ 成长的道路上我们会遇到很多困难， 经历很多事情， 这个地图 它是多人合作冒险超乐趣关卡 也是治愈个人 直击心灵深处的温暖存在。 在这个快节奏的年代里， 压力总是无形的， 我们可能处在社会的某个角落里， 做着不同的工作有着不一样的压力， 但是有压力才有动力 ，才会‘把’ 和‘让’ 快乐要求来的更简单 ， 就如短暂进入游戏世界会让我们忘掉很多 当然每个人经历的不一样 感受也不一样 因此我把本地图起名为‘黎明’ 就是希望它能像初生的太阳 照亮我们心灵的最深处 即使一丝微光也能感染到你我他！ 游戏愉快 ~

title: Time Trasher
description: Welcome to “Time Trashers”, my contribution to the Human: Fall Flat workshop competition (Lost in Time) and the wackiest adventure you've ever fallen into! Use your wobbly limbs to bend time, solve unique puzzles, and save the future...and some extraterrestrial visitors! SPOILERS AHEAD Starting Point: Trashy Future You wake up in a dystopian future, where there are loads of fires and trees are mere torches. Trash bags and buzzing flies are everywhere. Watch out, those pesky flies will knock you off your feet faster than you can say “oops”! Your first tasks? Avoid those flies and try to clean up the trashy mess. Maybe five bags will do? Or maybe you'll just create a bigger mess… Either way, time to get moving! Possible Achievement: Waste of Time – Throw away 5 trash bags UFO-topia You stumble onto a strange island. Inside a futuristic building, filled with bizarre gizmos and wonky widgets, you will find a time machine. Start it up, and whoosh! You're zapped to the past. Suddenly, the flames are gone. But wait, the time machine’s missing a crucial part. However, the UFO's back in the sky, ready to beam you up and transport you. Off you go to the next island! Farm Frenzy Welcome to a farm with a twist: a switch to flip night and day. Only in the daylight the lotus flowers will bloom, creating a floral bridge to the next destination. Get your timing right, or you'll be doing a lot of swimming! Did you recognize that the missing part of the time machine is locked up? It seems like the key is in the soil… Maybe you need to plant something here? But where to find a seed? Try to move on! Geyser Dojo You will find a dojo and can make some noise with the wind gong. For the geysers a bit thinking is involved, maybe you need to do something with the rock? Ascend via the geyser to the dojo's roof, leap onto a tree, and zipline your way to the next island. Possible Achievement: Zen Master – Meditate for 30 seconds after hitting the gong. Trojan Trick Enter the fortress the sneaky way – inside a trojan horse… or human! However, you can also get inside with a battering ram… and a bit of force. Once inside, it’s time to play around with these pillars. Move them just right to get to the next door. Once outside again, use the mechanics to get with the bridge to the next island. Possible Achievement: I am the Present! – Use the trojan horse to enter the fortress Pyramid Climb Get up the mysterious pyramid and take a wild ride down a slide. Send a cart crashing into a big rock to clear your path. You may need another try to get to the island, but rock and roll, baby! Possible Achievement: Hit the Road – Crash yourself in the big rock Back to the future Back at the start, but this time: No more trash, just beautiful nature. Grab a seed and with your precious cargo, head back to the UFO, get back to the farm, and plant that seed. Wait...you need sunlight? You're lucky the mirror can refract the light...daytime is needed though. And voila! The growing plant hands you the key to free the missing time machine part. Ask the aliens for another ride and get back to the future! Possible Achievement: Gotcha – Lock yourself up in the cage Future Finale Back in the future, your seed has sprouted into a magnificent tree, and the UFO's stuck in its branches. It seems like you saved the whole world, where is all the trahs and fire? Well...those nasty aliens would have distributed so much garbage if you didn't stop them eventually leading to the worlds end! Or maybe you saved the world by planting a tree? Who knows... One last beam-up, and you’ve reached the end of your ridiculous journey. Possible Achievement: Beam me Up, again – Complete the level

This level is a parkour mountain-climbing challenge themed around Norse mythology. The story of this level goes like this: You're an explorer, super curious about the land of giants, planning to delve deeper into its secrets. Along your journey, you encounter a massive Mjolnir hammer blocking your path, and behind a floating castle, there's an enormous giant sculpture impaled by huge pillars. It looks more like the remains of a giant's body rather than just a sculpture. You're puzzled – maybe there was a war in the land of giants. To uncover the full story, you decide to keep heading towards the snowy mountains that lead to the giant's realm. Note: This map level has undergone multiple rounds of testing. Each obstacle and terrain height, as well as the distances, are intentionally designed. Players need to make full use of the nearby objects on the map to keep exploring forward. Thank you so much for playing! If you enjoy it, please give this map a big thumbs-up and subscribe! Much appreciated. ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)✧

title: H120NEXTGENTECH_TEST V1.2
description: Warning, this is not a real map. Well, it is a map, but a test map What does this next generation of H120 bring? Everything I was previously told was impossible Active NPCS ''Chase the player, have voice lines and can die'' '''''TEMPORARILY DISABLED''''' Fluid physics, Yes, like the ones you saw in blender, but in a very simplified way, I see it sufficient, There is a spawner cube where you can choose how it will fall, The water physics are incredibly optimized, with a new gravity technique to render it hyper fast, and also with a collision system, with that they can push the players, and all the physical objects, probably in the future I will find more use for this technology 3D Materials, to add fake relief, and immense detail, in the future I will improve it Volumetric Clouds, Yes, there is not much to clarify, In short they are 3D clouds Day and night cycle + rain with physics + stars at night + a new Fog system Fake lights, YES they look ugly, But, they save an infernal amount of performance, I will probably use it for giant maps where I have to using absurd amounts of lights Real-time reflections ''LIMITED TO LOW FPS TEMPORARILY'' This is extremely new, I already have a trick to make the Reflection Probes refresh every certain period of time, as the cooks say, we don't tell secrets Everything mentioned above is done and refined to work in Online mode and obviously Split-Screen Warning, these systems are still in work, that's why this is a test map, if you find errors, it would be a huge favor for me if you report them to me, so I have them completely noted and refined to use definitively in my future maps of the next generation of H120

The design of the mechanisms is mostly original, and I personally find the process design quite challenging. The focus was largely on creative elements (as I'm not very skilled in art), and almost everything was made by myself. The creation process was very difficult, so I welcome everyone to come and experience this adventure. 夹子机关有穿模bug（我无法解决，但影响不是很大），可能还有多人bug，因为我没有好好处理net identity，所以建议单人游玩。机关设计基本全原创，我个人觉得流程设计相当有挑战性，制作重心也是创意要素居多（因为美术不太会）几乎全由个人制作，制作非常不易，欢迎大家来体验这场冒险 unity校园挑战赛参赛作品

description: 夜幕如浓稠墨砚晕染穹苍，皓洁弯月悬于九天之上，清辉亮似淬霜银镰，裁破万顷夜色，漫洒的月华如练如绸，铺就秘境清润底色。远接天际的浩渺烟波与澄澈湖泊交融，弯月倒影凝于镜水之上，银辉沉璧，风过涟漪轻漾，转瞬复归静美，难辨天月坠海，还是海月升天。 岸畔星星树枝桠疏朗，缀满星子般碎光，与天幕繁星交相辉映，恰似银河揉碎撒落枝头；成片灵植缀露吐芳，花苞凝着夜雾珠玑，月华下绽出莹润柔光，花瓣舒展间，漫出清浅幽芳。万千萤火虫携淡绿星子微光，自花丛溪畔翩跹而起，或蹁跹盘旋，或掠水而过，尾端萤光如星垂落，与星月倒影、花枝莹光交织，织就一片流动星河。 无尘世喧嚣，无俗事纷扰，唯有风拂草木簌簌轻吟，溪水潺潺低唱浅和。时光缓行，星月为盟，流萤为友，星树凝光，繁花吐韵，满溢诗意与清宁漫溢四野，漫入秘境每一寸肌理，恍若仙府遗世清梦，藏着天地间最纯粹的静谧祥和。

title: 云漫蓝海时
description: 天穹之上：​ 澄澈如洗的蓝天铺展至视线尽头，几缕蓬松的白云慵懒地悬着，似被夏末的风轻轻托住。阳光不再似盛夏那般灼热，而是化作柔和的金纱，慢悠悠地洒向海面与岸堤，给每一处景物都镀上温软的光晕。​ 碧波之畔：​ 一望无际的大海泛着粼粼波光，浅蓝与深蓝在浪尖处渐变交融。海浪褪去了往日的汹涌，只带着细碎的泡沫，轻轻拍打着岸边的礁石与沙滩，像在低声诉说着夏日即将落幕的絮语。​ 岸芷之侧：​ 岸边的花草仍凝着盛夏的余韵，雏菊顶着嫩黄的花盘，小花在风中摇曳，连空气里都飘着淡淡的草木清香。绿意盎然的树木随风轻晃，叶片间偶尔洒下太阳的光晕，悄无声息地落在草丛里，悄悄标记着季节更迭的痕迹。​ 夏与海的告别： 在这里，没有喧嚣的热闹，只有夏末独有的宁静与温柔。每一阵海风、每一次浪涌、每一片摇曳的枝叶，都藏着 “夏与海即将告别” 的细腻情绪，等待着玩家踏入这片天地，慢慢感受这份浪漫又带着淡淡怅惘的夏日终章。​ ------------ 本地图没有死亡点，请各位玩家酌情偷鸡，祝游戏愉快。

description: kiki送尤物的生日礼物图 祝小雯暴富！！！！ Happy Spring Festival！ 进阶连跳 ----------WARNING-------- This map needs more skills,you must konw how to jump far and how to control your direction and speed during jumping. But it is easy for some players esppecially the jump-player in China.If you want to finsh the map,you need to pracitce everyday and pay more time on it. ========警告========== 这不是一张萌新图，的确前面有些关卡会比较简单，但是后面是关卡难度较高 连跳需要你能够较完美的掌控起跳的速度以及在跳跃中如何改变方向。如果你 是一个新手玩家但是真的想很好的跳完这个地图，我建议你们先去尝试简单的 连跳图。当然此图对于娴熟的连跳玩家来说还是非常简单的 =======警告======== このマップは、より多くのスキルを必要とする そして、ジャンプ中にあなたの方向と速度を制御する方法。 しかし、それは簡単にいくつかのプレーヤーのためにESPPEPERABLE イン中国ならあなたはマップを終了するには、あなたが 毎日、それに多くの時間を支払う。 ======경고 하 다.====== 이 지 도 는 더 많은 기 교 를 필요 로 하 니, 너 는 어떻게 멀리뛰기 하 는 지 알 아야 한다. 그리고 점프 할 때 방향 과 속 도 를 조절 하 는 방법. 그러나 일부 운동선수 에 게 는, 특히 멀리뛰기 선수 에 게 는 쉬 운 일이 다. 있다.하면, 만약, 만약...네가 지 도 를 찾 으 려 면 연습 을 해 야 한다. 매일 더 많은 시간 을 쓴다. =====Warnung======= Diese Karte benötigt mehr Fähigkeiten, müssen Sie wissen, wie man weit zu springen und wie Sie Ihre Richtung und Geschwindigkeit beim Springen steuern. Aber es ist leicht für einige Spieler ganz besonders der Jump-Player inChina.IfSie wollen die Karte finden, müssen Sie pracite jeden Tag und mehr Zeit dafür zahlen.

But it is easy for some players esppecially the jump-player in China.If you want to finsh the map,you need to pracitce everyday and pay more time on it. ========警告========== 这不是一张萌新图，的确前面有些关卡会比较简单，但是后面是关卡难度较高 连跳需要你能够较完美的掌控起跳的速度以及在跳跃中如何改变方向。如果你 是一个新手玩家但是真的想很好的跳完这个地图，我建议你们先去尝试简单的 连跳图。当然此图对于娴熟的连跳玩家来说还是非常简单的 =======警告======== このマップは、より多くのスキルを必要とする そして、ジャンプ中にあなたの方向と速度を制御する方法。 しかし、それは簡単にいくつかのプレーヤーのためにESPPEPERABLE イン中国ならあなたはマップを終了するには、あなたが 毎日、それに多くの時間を支払う。 ======경고 하 다.====== 이 지 도 는 더 많은 기 교 를 필요 로 하 니, 너 는 어떻게 멀리뛰기 하 는 지 알 아야 한다. 그리고 점프 할 때 방향 과 속 도 를 조절 하 는 방법. 그러나 일부 운동선수 에 게 는, 특히 멀리뛰기 선수 에 게 는 쉬 운 일이 다. 있다.하면, 만약, 만약...네가 지 도 를 찾 으 려 면 연습 을 해 야 한다. 매일 더 많은 시간 을 쓴다. =====Warnung======= Diese Karte benötigt mehr Fähigkeiten, müssen Sie wissen, wie man weit zu springen und wie Sie Ihre Richtung und Geschwindigkeit beim Springen steuern. Aber es ist leicht für einige Spieler ganz besonders der Jump-Player inChina.IfSie wollen die Karte finden, müssen Sie pracite jeden Tag und mehr Zeit dafür zahlen.

description: 进阶连跳 ----------WARNING-------- This map needs more skills,you must konw how to jump far and how to control your direction and speed during jumping. But it is easy for some players esppecially the jump-player in China.If you want to finsh the map,you need to pracitce everyday and pay more time on it. ========警告========== 这不是一张萌新图，的确前面有些关卡会比较简单，但是后面是关卡难度较高 连跳需要你能够较完美的掌控起跳的速度以及在跳跃中如何改变方向。如果你 是一个新手玩家但是真的想很好的跳完这个地图，我建议你们先去尝试简单的 连跳图。当然此图对于娴熟的连跳玩家来说还是非常简单的 =======警告======== このマップは、より多くのスキルを必要とする そして、ジャンプ中にあなたの方向と速度を制御する方法。 しかし、それは簡単にいくつかのプレーヤーのためにESPPEPERABLE イン中国ならあなたはマップを終了するには、あなたが 毎日、それに多くの時間を支払う。 ======경고 하 다.====== 이 지 도 는 더 많은 기 교 를 필요 로 하 니, 너 는 어떻게 멀리뛰기 하 는 지 알 아야 한다. 그리고 점프 할 때 방향 과 속 도 를 조절 하 는 방법. 그러나 일부 운동선수 에 게 는, 특히 멀리뛰기 선수 에 게 는 쉬 운 일이 다. 있다.하면, 만약, 만약...네가 지 도 를 찾 으 려 면 연습 을 해 야 한다. 매일 더 많은 시간 을 쓴다. =====Warnung======= Diese Karte benötigt mehr Fähigkeiten, müssen Sie wissen, wie man weit zu springen und wie Sie Ihre Richtung und Geschwindigkeit beim Springen steuern. Aber es ist leicht für einige Spieler ganz besonders der Jump-Player inChina.IfSie wollen die Karte finden, müssen Sie pracite jeden Tag und mehr Zeit dafür zahlen.

title: 浅浅的十八岁成年生日图！
description: 这是浅浅的第四张图，也是意义非凡的一张图，希望大家喜欢。 This is Qianqian’s forth map, also a significant map, hope you guys all enjoy it. 游戏里一些关卡分为Holmes通道和浅浅通道，Holmes是浅浅的师父，所以请选择适合自己的通道哦~ There are two ways in some levels, the way with “Holmes” is harder than the other one, please choose the one that you are interested in. 发表这张图的这一天是我的18岁生日，也是给成年的自己的第一份礼物。希望以后的我也能像现在这样爱自己，爱身边的人，爱这个世界。 在这里想感谢一下我所有玩一败涂地和不玩一败涂地的朋友，你们每一个都是我过去18年里的一部分。你们的出现，不论是开心还是无奈，都是我一生中珍贵的回忆。最最感谢的是我的师父Holmes，从认识的第一天开始就教了我许多游戏里的小技巧，之后也在游戏外给了我很多有用的建议。虽然有时候会起一些小的争执，但是他经常说我是他从一败涂地里捡来的，成天操心哈哈哈哈。亲爱的Holmxi还在做图上给了很多建议。我在做第二张图（粉色需要冰面急停的）的时候还因为第一版做的太差被Holmxi骂了qwq，后来就全图删掉重新做了。他的严厉让我对做图更用心，也从做图中获得了更大的乐趣，也让我明白要高标准要求自己，对自己决定做的事情全心全意。（悄悄告诉你们，这次测图的时候并没有给Holmxi看到这些话，他看到了一定会说“我哪有这么好的，别这么夸奥”）以后也会努力做出更好的作品来坑他的！ 今年其实是第一次一个人过生日，一直很担心，没有家人在身边。（我是留学生，今年因为疫情没有回去）总是在想，自己的十八岁生日为什么就这么凄凉。三个月之前就想明白了，既然回不去，就要自己把这个生日过得有意义。于是开始学习怎样在一败涂地做图，也已经做了三个图来练手。这次的生日图是用了很久和很大精力来做的，希望它至少不成为我的遗憾。这种特别的礼物送给自己，是种特别的自豪和特别的记忆。 也谢谢玩了我的图的你们。第一张图发出来的时候真的很紧张啊，那个时候就是每两个小时看一下自己的订阅数和评分。睡了一觉起来第二天订阅人数一下就涨到了一千多，当时真的很惊喜。那是我第一次感受到自己的努力与获得的结果。我最开始想的是只要有人玩我的图，玩的过程很开心，我的图就做得有意义。在看到逐渐增长的订阅人数和不低的评分后，我发现这一切都是有意义的。这也会是我接下来一直做图的动力。善良的你们给了我的图很高的分数。谢谢你们的支持，没有你们真的没有现在的我。 这里还要另外感谢一下在做图中帮助过我的朋友--Holmes, kiyomi, Treasure, 将军，哆啦，以及一位不愿提供姓名的帅哥。 It is my eighteen-year-old birthday, and this map is a gift for myself as an adult. Hope I can still love myself, my friends, and this world, as much as I do now. Thanks for people who help me on making maps, you are the light on my way. Thanks for people who played my maps, you are my power on my way. Thanks for people who appeared in my life, you are all my special parts in my life.

title: 世外桃源
description: 你在桃树旁矗立，这里没有蓝天 因为都被这颗卑鄙的树染成了紫色 你很失望 所以你迈开步子向前走去 脚底是倦人的泥石路 而眼前是黄昏紫霞 这是一片我看不到的天空 你在沙发上坐下 让碧绿套衫渗入你纤细的腰 灰蒙的雾气在凝望 电视的屏幕在闪烁 这里只有你，并没有我 你终于看腻了这黄昏 低头望着山下 雾气遮住了视野，没有声响 能看见隐约的桃源山城 而我相信，你还看见了光 我终究还是困在了世外的桃源里 虽能感受鲜息的美丽 却不能沐浴爱意的波浪 最重要的是，在我眼里，这里其实没有一点光 但也没有什么值得颓丧的 因为光去了一个神圣的地方 最后，我想问你一句 亲爱的，你能看见光吗？

title: Big Tunnel
description: A long track to test speeds and stuff. There's a light at the end of the tunnel. The wall textures are glitching because of them being so long. The floor texture is just a stretched default Unity grid. I got lucky because the texture isn't glitchy, plus it has nice straight lines. The dimensions of the tunnel: 500,000 units long 195.057 units high 177.8 units wide Info: I just did a quick search on average heights of humans, and got 5' 9" for men and 5' 4" for women. I used the average of those two: 5' 6.5" In Unity, the human player model is about 1.555 units tall. Now, my math could honestly be wrong, but as far as I know I didn't mess anything up I hope. Anyway did some other conversions and I got these: Distances: 1 foot = 0.2806 units 1 meter = 0.9206 units 1 kilometer = 920.604 units 1 mile = 1,481.57 units 1 lightyear = 8,709,594,994,146,737 units Speed: 1 m/s = 0.9206 units/second 1 km/h = 0.255723 units/second 1 mph = 0.411547 units/second 1 mach = 315.767 units/second 1x speed of light = 275,989,822.7 units/second Earth has a circumference of about 25,000 miles, and this map is about 500,000 units, so: 500,000 units / 1481.57 = 337.4798356 ≈ 337.48 miles Sadly not as big as the Earth. For that, it would have to be 37,039,250 units long. Again, this is all just approximation and the player height could be completely different considering the goofy proportions.
